**UXUC81C** is a specific medical procedure code used in the Danish healthcare system to designate transesophageal echocardiography with contrast [^src1]. It is included in the official list of [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] (echocardiography) codes used in the Sygesikringsregisteret (National Health Service Register) and is thereby integral to the quality measurement of diagnostic practices for patients with atrial fibrillation ([[atrieflimren]]) [^src1].

Within the national clinical quality databases managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), UXUC81C is grouped under the broader indicator area for echocardiography [^src2]. The specific echocardiography indicator area includes the procedure codes [[uxuc80c|UXUC80C]], [[uxuc80d|UXUC80D]], [[uxuc80e|UXUC80E]], [[uxuc81|UXUC81]], and UXUC81C [^src1]. These codes are extracted from national health registers to calculate clinical quality metrics, ensuring standardized data collection and enabling cross-regional comparisons of cardiovascular care across Denmark [^src1].
